suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-13: Dependency-Check incorrectly maps this Jetpack Compose runtime library to cpe:2.3:a:github:github:0.15.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*. These four CVEs affect GitHub Enterprise Server (Pages command execution, private repository name disclosure, and public-key mass assignment). The Android library contains none of those server components. Limited to the reviewed package version and CVEs; re-evaluate on upgrade. https://github.com/skydoves/compose-stability-analyzer https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-server@2.21/admin/release-notes https://github.com/blog/1068-public-key-security-vulnerability-and-mitigation
